note: The vulnerable `md2_guard` marker is inserted in `parse_odp_push_nsh_action` immediately after `md_size = mdlen + padding;` and before `ofpbuf_uninit(&b)`, so every bound field there maps directly to an in-scope vulnerable expression: `md_size`, `sizeof metadata`, `b.data`, and `metadata`. The sink marker records the actual `nullable_memcpy(dst, src, n)` operands, so `memcpy_sink.src_ptr` and `memcpy_sink.copy_size` bind directly to `src` and `n` in the vulnerable original. The fixed instrumentation reuses the same event names but may compute the guarded `md2_guard` values earlier to preserve the root-obligation witness even when the fixed build rejects the oversized original PoC before the sink.
